note: P4379 (Pro 30:29) — three things are stately in their tread; four are stately in their stride.

dims.v: dignified confidence — the majestic, unhurried bearing of the assured

the stately tread of four creatures (lion, strutting cock, he-goat, and the king with his army) — the dignified, confident, unhurried bearing that comes of assurance and mastery, majesty expressed in how one carries oneself
the confident dignity that shows itself in an unhurried, majestic gait

yatab (be good / stately) — 'three things are STATELY in their tread' (30:29-31); dignity of bearing — the lion unafraid, the king secure among his people — expresses inner assurance and mastery. A stately walk is confidence made visible.
